aiResearchSummary.text: TurbineOne is engaged in developing systems for synchronizing nodes in a network, as described in 'Synchronizing nodes in a network,' which details processes for transmitting multicast beacons and handling unicast synchronization requests among squad nodes. Additionally, 'Communication management between mesh-networked mobile nodes' outlines methods for coordinating computational resources and managing work requests among mobile nodes. These efforts focus on networked node coordination and resource sharing.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $36,000,000, or 66.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $18,333,019 to $300,000,000, a 16.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
